to.shell_command:
/usr/bin/osascript <<'EOF'
tell application "System Events"
  repeat with proc in (processes where background only is false)
    tell proc
      try
        set value of attribute "AXMinimized" of windows to true
      end try
    end tell
  end repeat
end tell
EOF

rules.description: [PATCH] Global Ctrl+W / Ctrl+T -> Cmd+W / Cmd+T (exclude VS Code/JetBrains + terminals)

manipulators.description: Shift + Home = Select to beginning of line
Shift + End = Select to end of line
Home = Move to beginning of line
End = Move to end of line

rules.description: [CORE] Text navigation — Ctrl+Arrows = macOS Option+Arrows (exclude terminals)

manipulators.description: Ctrl+Shift+Left Arrow = Select the previous word by moving the caret one word to the left while extending the selection
Ctrl+Shift+Right Arrow = Select the next word by moving the caret one word to the right while extending the selection
Ctrl+Left Arrow = Move the caret to the beginning of the previous word
Ctrl+Right Arrow = Move the caret to the beginning of the next word
Fn + Left Arrow = Move caret to the beginning of the current line
Fn + Right Arrow = Move caret to the end of the current line
Fn + Shift + Left Arrow = Select text from the cursor to the beginning of the line
Fn + Shift + Right Arrow = Select text from the cursor to the end of the line
Fn + Ctrl + Shift + Left Arrow = Extend selection upward to the beginning of the document (or to the top)
Fn + Ctrl + Shift + Right Arrow = Extend selection downward to the end of the document (or to the bottom)

rules.description: [CORE] Ctrl shortcuts → Cmd shortcuts (exclude VS Code/JetBrains + terminals)
[CORE] Ctrl+Backspace/Delete — Delete word (exclude VS Code/JetBrains + terminals)
[BROWSERS] Parity pack — tabs, refresh (F5), address bar, incognito, devtools, tab jump
[BROWSERS] Chromium extras — Downloads/History/Clear data/Zoom + Inspect Element
[VS CODE] Ctrl+Tab = Back to most recent tab + Win+Space = Quick Open

manipulators.description: Ctrl+Tab = back to least recent tab + Win+Space = Quick Open
ATL TAB = switch to most recent app (CMD TAB)
ATL SHIFT TAB = switch to least recent app (CMD TAB)
ATL SHIFT F4 = close app (CMD Q)
Shift Delete = Empty Trash (CMD OPTION Delete)
Shift Forward Delete = Empty Trash (CMD OPTION Delete)

rules.description: [WIN CLIPBOARD] Ctrl+Insert=Copy, Shift+Insert=Paste, Shift+Delete=Cut (both Delete types)
[WIN LAYER] Win key shortcuts (Win = RIGHT_CMD) — system + window management (Rectangle + AppleScript)

manipulators.description: Win+Shift+Left/Right = Move window to previous/next monitor (Rectangle)
